title: Seat Cover for Ride-On Mower – Hard-Wearing 600D Oxford
descriptionHtml:
Tired of a wet, hot and cracked seat?

The original cushion on the ride-on mower dries out, cracks and turns rock hard after just a couple of seasons in sun and rain. You sit down on a soaked seat in the morning, a scorching one in the afternoon – and every bump in the lawn goes straight into your back. What should be comfortable becomes the worst part of mowing the lawn.

The solution: saves the seat in under 60 seconds

Our seat cover in heavy-duty 600D Oxford fabric slips straight on over your existing cushion. The water-repellent fabric keeps your backside dry, the padded inside gives a softer ride and the adjustable straps hold everything firmly in place – even on bumpy ground. No tools, no hassle. Slip it on, strap it down, drive.

Features

  • Heavy-duty 600D Oxford fabric – withstands sun, rain and daily use season after season.
  • Water-repellent surface – a dry, comfortable seat even after rain and morning dew.
  • Adjustable straps – stays firmly in place and doesn't slide while driving.
  • Universal fit – fits most ride-on mowers and garden tractors.
  • Goes on in under 60 seconds – no tools needed.
  • Several colors – pick the one that suits your machine.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
